capabilities.description: Write the record of a pull request or issue, asking gh which it is and its title, or report the record already there without asking.

inputSchema.description: Record one pull request or issue.

ref.description: The pull request or issue as owner/repo#number, such as octo/widgets#12.
ref.title: Ref

inputSchema.title: RefInput

capabilities.name: ref

outputSchema.description:
The record for the reference, and whether this call wrote it.

`written` is false when the record was already there; nothing was asked of
GitHub and nothing was written. `title` is null when the record holds none.
outputSchema.title: RefOutput

description: Record a GitHub pull request or issue as a typed record that other records can reference. Use it when a record should name a pull request or issue. Run `board -C <board> call github.ref --ref <owner>/<repo>#<number>`, then reference the `path` it returns. SKILL.md and README.md in the plugin's directory say more.
name: github
